Bao cao Kho than · Nhap mat khau de tiep tuc
Noi dung duoc ma hoa — chi hien thi sau khi nhap dung mat khau.
Doi mat khau dang nhap
Chua co token? Xem cach tao, chi can lam 1 lan. Token chi dung dung luc bam nut ben duoi, khong luu lai o dau ca - de trong neu muon tu tai file len GitHub bang tay.
  1. Vao github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new, dang nhap dung tai khoan dang quan ly repo.
  2. Dat ten bat ky, Repository access chon Only select repositories roi chon dung repo Dashboard-BC-PXNL.
  3. Muc Permissions, Repository permissions, tim dong Contents, chon Read and write.
  4. Bam Generate token, copy doan ma bat dau bang github_pat_ va dan vao o Token o tren.
Bam nut duoi de luu file dashboard_password.txt moi thang vao thu muc POWER BI KHO THAN tren may, ghi de file cu. Bo qua buoc nay se khien lan tu dong chay tiep theo doi lai mat khau cu.
Tai file ben duoi, ghi de vao file index.html trong thu muc dong bo tren may. Sau do mo file dashboard_password.txt cung thu muc va doi thanh dung mat khau moi, luu lai.
